files.description: The complete EHI export documentation page for ehrTHOMAS. Single HTML page containing introduction, how-to instructions, and XML sample snippets for 8 data domains (Patient, Encounter, Device, Immunization, Allergy, Procedure, Vital, Condition). References §170.315(b)(10). This is the entirety of the vendor's EHI export documentation.

Screenshot of the ehrTHOMAS Reports Menu showing the 'Electronic Health Information (Export)' button. Annotated with red circles indicating (1) the Reports button in the bottom toolbar and (2) the EHI Export button in the Reports Menu grid. Shows the full Reports Menu with other options like Appointment List, Audit Log, CDS Alerts, etc.

Screenshot of the 'Export: Electronic Health Information' dialog configured for single-patient export. Shows: Export Folder Path (C:\Users\RashidM\Documents\EHRElectronicHealthInformation\02), Export Type set to 'Single Patient', patient search field with 'mouse' entered, two matching patients displayed (Mickey Mouse), and Export/Cancel buttons. Annotated with numbered steps 1-4.

Screenshot of the 'Export: Electronic Health Information' dialog configured for all-patients export. Shows: Export Folder Path, Export Type set to 'All Patients (Entire Database)', and Export/Cancel buttons. Annotated with numbered steps 1-2.

Full-page browser screenshot of the EHI export documentation page as rendered in Chrome. Captures the complete page including title, introduction, all three embedded screenshots, terms and conditions, and all 8 XML dataset samples.
